_doc: Model and effort per subagent tier (Shay 2026-10-14). tools/automation/hooks/agent-router.ps1 sets model and effort from here on every Agent call in this project, and enforces the cascade gates (debug needs a FAIL verdict; escalate needs a debug round and a later FAIL). event-sweep.sh checks verdicts for work cases patch, generate, debug, escalate and investigate. The solo case is a benchmark baseline only. The grade case (kenshi-grader, Sonnet high) scores two finished outputs blind and writes a grade file, not a verdict. Prices and reasoning: docs/MODEL_ROUTING.md.
